task.ques: Check out LeBron James' Stats to see how many games he has played in his career so far.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: LeBron James has played 1,625 career NBA regular-season games as of October 28, 2026. ESPN’s Stats page shows 1625 under GP (Games Played) in the Career row, with Regular Season selected. Evidence: final.png. Source: https://www.espn.com/nba/player/stats/_/id/1966/lebron-james
